articles.title: 'Throwing Muck At The Dead': Abhijit Iyer-Mitra On Sonia Gandhi’s Memoir I 1984, Godhra, Emergency
articles.description: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love has reopened contentious debates around the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, Godhra, the Emergency and the Gandhi family’s political legacy. Speaking to Times Of India’s Aditi Prasad on Why Should You Care?, political analyst Abhijit Iyer-Mitra argues that Sonia’s treatment of Sanjay Gandhi, Maneka Gandhi, Narendra Modi, the RSS and former allies raises questions about selective outrage, omission and long-held grudges. From “throwing muck at the dead” to portraying Pranab Mukherjee as overly ambitious, Abhijit examines the contradictions and political consequences of Sonia Gandhi’s memoir.
